subject: OrionBank IAM evidence and least-privilege workplan
messages:
From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@orionbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@orionbank.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrionBank — initial IAM evidence request

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. OrionBank's compliance team needs a package of artifacts to complete our SOC 2 + vendor intake review. Can you provide the following items scoped to our tenant (tenant-id: ORN-94) and the last 90 days where applicable?

- SCIM delta exports (CSV preferred) showing create/update/delete events for user and group objects for the past 90 days. We need schema headers and sample timestamps.
- SAML assertion samples (IdP→SP) for at least three authentication flows (employee, contractor, service account), with any PII redacted.
- RBAC mapping: role → permission matrix and a current owner/steward for each role.
- Snapshot of service accounts and machine identities, including last-used timestamps and associated scopes.
- Evidence of ephemeral/jit admin rotation (audit logs or rotation excerpts).
- Short narrative (1 page) on how Redwood enforces least privilege and role lifecycle (creation → assignment → revocation).

Preferred delivery: secure shared Drive link or SFTP. Our reviewer is Tom Ellis (cc'd); he may forward to our auditor. Can you confirm a delivery timeline? If any of these items require a narrower scope (e.g., you can only provide samples), please flag that up front.

Thanks,
Natalie Ruiz
Vendor Risk Manager — OrionBank
[natalie.ruiz@orionbank.com]

[Attachment: orionbank_intake_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@orionbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrionBank — initial IAM evidence request

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear list. I'll coordinate this from the sales side and loop in our security/controls team to assemble the evidence. Quick notes:

- We can provide SCIM delta samples and a full sampled export for the 90-day window; we'll mark any data we redact.
- SAML assertions will be sanitized (no PII) and labeled by flow.
- RBAC mapping and service account snapshot are straightforward; we'll include owners.
- Ephemeral admin rotation: we can deliver a rotation_log excerpt and a short narrative of our JIT process.

Proposed timeline:
- Initial packet (sample artifacts + intake checklist) within 3 business days.
- Full deliverable (complete zipped evidence / drive folder) within 10 business days, unless you request a narrower or broader scope.

Delivery method: we prefer a secure Drive folder (we'll send a pre-provisioned link) — if you need SFTP, let us know and we can arrange it.

I've created a HubSpot intake (ORION-12345) and assigned to our controls lead. Laura and Jonas — can you confirm the list below and add any gating items?

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

[Attachment: intake_checklist.txt (text/plain)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@orionbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrionBank — initial IAM evidence request

Hi Natalie, Ben — Laura from Security here. I've reviewed the ask and outlined our deliverables and constraints below. We can meet the proposed timeline; here's how we'll package items and what to expect for redaction.

Deliverables (what we'll put in the Drive folder):
1) SCIM delta sample: CSV formatted slice named "orionbank_scim_delta_sample.csv". Columns: event_time, op_type, resource_type, resource_id, attribute_changes (JSON-string), source_system. The sample will include representative create/update/delete events spanning the 90-day window. Full delta exports: available as a zipped CSV if agreed.

2) SAML assertions: sanitized raw assertion snippets (base64-decoded and redacted) in "saml_assertion_samples.txt". We'll provide three labeled examples (employee, contractor, service-account) and a short note describing which assertion attributes are present/required (NameID format, audience, authnContext).

3) RBAC matrix: "rbac_mapping_matrix.xlsx" with tabs for Roles, Permissions, RoleOwners. Each role will have a short justification field and last-assigned timestamp.

4) Service account inventory: CSV snapshot with last-used timestamp, associated scopes, and linked service owner.

5) Ephemeral admin rotation evidence: aggregated rotation logs (redacted) in "rotation_log_excerpt.jsonl" showing rotation events and duration of elevated access.

6) Narrative: one-page PDF describing least-privilege policies, role lifecycle, SCIM provisioning cadence, and revocation SLA.

Redaction policy: we will remove any full SSNs/email addresses that are not necessary for the auditor. Timestamps will be preserved. If you require unredacted samples under an NDA, we can discuss an additional secure exchange.

Gating questions for OrionBank:
- Do you need user ids in SCIM to match a specific internal key (e.g., ORN-emp-id) or is Redwood's UUID acceptable for mapping?
- For service accounts, do you want last-used to include token-id or just timestamp + client-id?

Next steps: We'll stage the artifacts in a pre-provisioned Drive folder and post the link to HubSpot. Ben / Jonas will track delivery and audit responses.

Laura Bennett
Security Controls Lead — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

[Attachment: rbac_mapping_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@orionbank.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@orionbank.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrionBank — initial IAM evidence request

Hi Laura / Ben — appreciate the clear plan and redaction guidance. Drive delivery works best for us.

Answers to gating questions:
- Please include both Redwood UUID and our ORN-emp-id where available; mapping table is ideal.
- For service accounts, timestamp + client-id is sufficient; token ids are not required.

Can we book a short 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the RBAC matrix and ephemeral admin examples before you finalize the packet? Tom and I are available between 09:00–12:00 PT.

If that's agreeable, please send a calendar invite. Otherwise, the timeline looks good — thanks again.

Best,
Natalie Ruiz
Vendor Risk Manager — OrionBank
